title: Daniels Delivers in the Final Minute
paragraph: The Commanders faced the Giants on Thursday night. Washington needed a touchdown late in the game. Jayden Daniels threw a splendid 32-yard pass to Stefon Diggs! Diggs scored with 57 seconds left. The touchdown gave Washington a 24-21 win.

big_words.example: Sofia made a splendid science project.

source_title: Commanders' Daniels finds redemption with game-winning drive - ESPN
angle: Jayden Daniels threw a 32-yard touchdown with just 49 seconds left to give the Commanders a thrilling win over the Giants.

title: Donald’s Sack Attack Is Back!
paragraph: Aaron Donald and the Rams played the Cardinals in Arizona. Donald got his first sack in 1,050 days! He finished the game with 1.5 sacks. His remarkable day moved him to 31st on the NFL’s all-time sacks list. The Rams beat the Cardinals 34-6, and Donald said the win felt even better.

big_words.definition: So special that people notice it.
big_words.example: Jamal made remarkable progress at his swimming lesson.

source_title: Rams' Aaron Donald savors first sack in 1,050 days vs. Cardinals - ESPN
angle: Rams star Aaron Donald celebrated his first sack in 1,050 days and helped his team beat the Cardinals.

title: Parker Helps Jaguars Roar
paragraph: The Jaguars took on the Titans in Nashville. Parker Washington made a magnificent start! He caught a 2-yard touchdown pass from Trevor Lawrence. Washington also made a 50-yard catch and run to set up a field goal. He had 148 receiving yards in the first half. The Jaguars won 40-23 for their third straight win.

big_words.example: Hana's dog made a magnificent leap for its toy.

source_title: Five Key Plays From Jaguars' Week 10 Win Over Titans
angle: Parker Washington helped the Jaguars roar past the Titans 40-23 for their third straight win.

title: Niners Pile Up Points!
paragraph: The 49ers went to Dallas to play the Cowboys. San Francisco piled up 584 yards and won 46-40. Brock Purdy threw a 74-yard touchdown pass to Christian McCaffrey. Then Deebo Samuel Sr. ran 70 yards for another score. McCaffrey caught a 66-yard touchdown pass from Purdy, too! The Niners' enormous score was their most ever against the Cowboys.

big_words.example: Diego built an enormous tower with his blocks.

source_title: 49ers put up big numbers in victory over Cowboys - ESPN
angle: The 49ers piled up 584 yards and scored their most points ever against their Cowboys rivals.

title: Chargers Hold On in Baltimore
paragraph: The Chargers faced the Ravens on Monday night in Baltimore. Justin Herbert ran 22 yards for a touchdown. Omarion Hampton scored a touchdown, too. The Ravens stayed close, but the Chargers had a sturdy defense. Late in the game, Tarheeb Still forced a fumble! The Chargers held on to win 23-20, their first win of the season.

big_words.definition: Strong and not easily knocked down.
big_words.example: Ava carried her library book in a sturdy bag.

source_title: Chargers-Ravens on 'Monday Night Football': What We Learned from Los Angeles' 23-20 win over Baltimore | Latest NFL News, Analysis & Updates | NFL.com
